SELECT id, mcp_id, mcp_name, tool_name, tool_description, tool_description_zh, tool_intent_zh, input_schema_json, enabled, last_seen_at, create_time, update_time FROM ai_mcp_tool_catalog WHERE mcp_id = #{mcpId}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO ai_mcp_tool_catalog ( mcp_id, mcp_name, tool_name, tool_description, tool_description_zh, tool_intent_zh, input_schema_json, enabled, last_seen_at, create_time, update_time ) VALUES
( #{item.mcpId}, #{item.mcpName}, #{item.toolName}, #{item.toolDescription}, #{item.toolDescriptionZh}, #{item.toolIntentZh}, #{item.inputSchemaJson}, #{item.enabled}, #{item.lastSeenAt}, NOW(), NOW() )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE mcp_name = VALUES(mcp_name), tool_description = VALUES(tool_description), tool_description_zh = VALUES(tool_description_zh), tool_intent_zh = VALUES(tool_intent_zh), input_schema_json = VALUES(input_schema_json), enabled = VALUES(enabled), last_seen_at = VALUES(last_seen_at), update_time = NOW()
